description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SearchUserFriendlyException' within the 'SuiteCRM\Search\Exceptions' namespace. It extends 'SearchException' and is intended to encapsulate non-technical error messages that can be safely displayed to users during search operations.

classes.description: A user-friendly exception class for search errors that can be safely displayed to users. Extends SearchException.
